name: El Huevon Breakfast Tacos
eyebrow: Breakfast taco truck · San Antonio, Texas
tagline: Breakfast tacos from a truck on Potranco Road.
about: El Huevon Breakfast Tacos is a food truck at 10775 Potranco Rd in San Antonio.
Fillings include potato and chorizo, egg combinations and chicharrón en salsa verde.
